verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST-style API: contact search, list management, campaign setup, reports, and scoped API keys. Nothing mentions official SDKs or client libraries in any language. A raw API is an adjacent building block, not an official SDK, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no published spec from which SDKs could be generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
